meta.name: x402-payment
meta.description: Pay x402-protected HTTP APIs with the x402-cli command on TRON or BSC using USDT, USDD, or USDC. Use when an agent receives an HTTP 402 challenge, needs to inspect payment requirements safely, pay a protected URL, select exact or TRON exact_gasfree, or limit the amount/network/token before payment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行支付 HTTP 402 挑战的 API 费用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在收到 HTTP 402 时自动支付 USDT 等代币
copy.tagline_en: Pay HTTP 402-challenged APIs via command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically pay USDT tokens when receiving HTTP 402 challenges

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会用x402-cli命令支付受x402保护的HTTP API。它会先进行dry-run检查支付要求，然后根据你设定的金额、网络、代币等参数执行支付，支持TRON和BSC网络上的USDT、USDD、USDC。
howto.when: 当Claude收到HTTP 402支付挑战，或需要检查支付要求、支付受保护URL、选择exact或TRON exact_gasfree方案、或限制金额/网络/代币时触发。

say.text: 帮我支付这个URL，用USDT，最大金额0.01。
使用GasFree方案支付这个请求，费用上限0.5。
检查这个URL的支付要求，但不要真正支付。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the x402-cli command to pay x402-protected HTTP APIs. It first performs a dry-run to inspect payment requirements, then executes payment based on your specified amount, network, token, etc. Supports USDT, USDD, USDC on TRON and BSC networks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude receives an HTTP 402 challenge, or needs to inspect payment requirements, pay a protected URL, select exact or TRON exact_gasfree scheme, or limit amount/network/token before payment.

say_en.text: Pay this URL with USDT, max amount 0.01.
Pay this request using GasFree scheme, fee cap 0.5.
Inspect payment requirements for this URL without paying.
